translations.web: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
translations.bsb: And having disarmed the powers and authorities, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.
translations.kjv: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
translations.asv: having despoiled the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
